material.acceptance_criteria: A run of place-oscraft that ships a new model also writes its kind to doodads.json, with no hand edit.
material.description: hy3d found that place-oscraft wrote the six pillar models (pillar-rock-1..6-skinned) but did not add their kinds to doodads.json, so the 41 pillar doodad lines would resolve to nothing. hy3d added the six keys by hand. place-oscraft adds entries for other props, so a new batch will hit the same gap. Locate why it skips these kinds and fix the tool.
material.subject: place-oscraft shipped six pillar models but did not add their kinds to doodads.json
material.witness: temp-dir runs of the tool: before the fix pillar-rock-1 (already copied) got no key and pillar-rock-9 got pillar-rock-9_skinned; after the fix both get pillar-rock-1-skinned and pillar-rock-9-skinned and a rerun adds nothing. Live oscraft doodads.json untouched. hy3d publish 1c5cb2a9; hy3d has no ci-status route.
material.witness_plan: Run the tool on a batch with one new kind and confirm doodads.json gains the key, from a separate session.
